title: Refined Pickaxe
body:
"Tall and refined, this one will not let you down."

Description

Refined Pickaxe is a pickaxe that is sold at The Oak Depot. It can be bought for $21,000. It's one of the best pickaxes a player can buy.

Appearance

Refined Pickaxe is a tall pick that seems to be made out of refined steel and wood. It's headpiece is made out of refined steel; using the default legacy metal material as it's coating. It's handle is made out of wood, painted blue, having a thick rubber grip for maximum efficiency and accurate hits; using the default legacy sand material as it's coating.

Trivia

  • Due to an error in stats displayed in it's description, it was wrongly assumed, that it's stats are the same as Tall Steel Pickaxe. This mistake was corrected with the release of new UI.
  • It's axe counterpart is Refined Axe. Despite being in the same "series", Refined Axe has a greater significance than it's pickaxe counterpart.
